messages:
nina: Postmortem follow-up: observed recurring pattern where partials spike during nightly tenant snapshot jobs. Putting together a small mitigation plan and owners.

oliver: put me on the keepalive/GC tuning. I want to profile the runtime and see if we can move GC windows.

priya: I can own the short-term mitigation: add explicit server ack for final token and a client-side timeout extension if ack late. Will prototyping tomorrow.

oncall-bot: oncall team notified.

nina: acceptance criteria for this thread:
- snapshot windows insulated from serving threads or GC rescheduled
- final-token ack presence reduces partials from snapshots by 90% in test env
- SDK accepts server ack header and extends client timeout

oliver: ack. profiler run scheduled for tomorrow 0200 UTC.

priya: ack. will push sketch of protocol change to PR-4321 and link here.

nina: filing follow-on ticket: TKT-5533 for GC scheduling and TKT-5534 for protocol ack.

priya: also adding cheap telemetry: when final-ack missing, emit `final_ack_missing_total` tagged by route/tenant. will add that to the dashboard.

nina: thanks. we'll reconvene after profiler and PR reviews. :white_check_mark:
